name: AI Teens Studio
description: Awarded for completing and passing the AI Teens Studio track: supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement learning, how neural networks train, why models fail, language model decoding, deepfake detection, prompt injection, and honest academic use of AI.

criteria.narrative: Complete all 8 lessons and their interactive labs — including a hands-on gradient descent trainer and four decision simulators — then pass a 20-question assessment at 70% or above. The assessment is taken online and is not proctored.
